title: Gideon and the Static
author: Wendell Hartwell
blurb: Emrys Yarrow, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
